description: Isolated synthetic English fixtures for all seven landscape layouts (and variants) used for Quiz Layout Upgrade V2 characterization and testing.

fixtures.questionText: Which celestial body is known as the Red Planet?
fixtures.factCardText: Mars gets its red color from iron oxide, commonly known as rust, on its surface.

fixtures.questionText: Is Mars or Venus closer to the Sun?
fixtures.factCardText: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting closer than Mars.

fixtures.questionText: Identify the planet with the most extensive ring system.
fixtures.factCardText: Saturn has thousands of individual ringlets composed of water ice and cosmic dust.

fixtures.questionText: Which of these celestial objects is classified as a dwarf planet?
fixtures.factCardText: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet by the International Astronomical Union in 2006.

fixtures.questionText: Which animal achieves higher top running speeds?
fixtures.factCardText: Cheetahs can accelerate from zero to sixty miles per hour in just three seconds.

fixtures.questionText: Which ocean basin contains the Mariana Trench?
fixtures.factCardText: The Mariana Trench reaches a maximum known depth of nearly 36,000 feet in the Pacific.

fixtures.questionText: Lightning strikes the Earth more than one hundred times per second.
fixtures.factCardText: Global lightning detection networks register around 44 strikes every second on average.

fixtures.questionText: What chemical element has the symbol Au?
fixtures.factCardText: The chemical symbol Au comes from aurum, the Latin word for shining dawn.

fixtures.questionText: Is diamond an allotrope of carbon or silicon?
fixtures.factCardText: Diamond consists of pure carbon atoms arranged in a rigid tetrahedral lattice.

fixtures.questionText: Can you identify the mysterious landmark obscured behind the tiles?
fixtures.factCardText: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest human-made structure for over 3,800 years.
